title: Call cutting out while pitching Lazar interview

tellings.quote: Right. And the call kept cutting when I was saying that.

plain: Michels says that while he was on a phone call talking about doing an interview with Bob Lazar, a man who has long said he worked on alien craft for the government, the line kept cutting out right as he said it. He tells this himself, as something that happened to him, in a conversation with a guest named Dave Rossi. The point is the timing, the kind of detail people mention when they suspect someone is listening.
